findings.passage: “Voter ID is a cornerstone of our election process. Supporting this resolution to send it to referenda for the voters of Wisconsin to decide is vitally important,” said Rep. Born.
findings.note: Press release from his Assembly office on his vote for SJR 2, the photo ID constitutional amendment.

findings.passage: “Voter ID is supported by 74% of registered voters in Wisconsin. I am proud to cast my vote to preserve the integrity of our election system,” said Rep. Born.
findings.note: Same release; he cites public support and ties photo ID to election integrity.

findings.passage: “Voters should have fair and accountable access to early voting no matter where they live,” said Rep. Born. “This bill supports our clerks and ensures greater opportunity to cast a ballot.”
findings.note: Release on AB 312, minimum in-person absentee voting hours plus an election security grant program for clerks. Not about ID, but related election administration.
